verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry is documented as automatically identifying and aggregating low-value telemetry to cut costs (grafana-docs-14, grafana-docs-21, grafana-docs-28), showing some cost-management capability, but there is no evidence of per-team/service cost attribution dashboards, budget alerts, or spike-before-billing notifications. missing for 10: cost attribution by team/service, usage-spike/budget alerting tied to billing, independent hands-on confirmation of cost visibility features.
